jobs.title: SAP ILM ARCHIECT
jobs.description:
ROLE: SAP ILM ARCHIECT
 



 LOCATION: REMOTE
 



  





 We are seeking an experienced ILM Technical Architect to lead the design and execution of SAP Information Lifecycle Management (ILM) architecture for the SAP BRIM Archiving Project. The role requires deep expertise in SAP ILM, data archiving strategy, and SAP BRIM/S/4HANA landscapes, with strong ownership of architecture decisions, compliance alignment, and stakeholder engagement in an onsite (US remote) model
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design and own the SAP ILM architecture for BRIM data archiving and retention
* Define archiving strategy, data objects, retention rules, and lifecycle policies aligned with business and compliance requirements
* Lead ILM configuration and technical design, including object selection, rule assignment, and data flow design
* Work closely with SAP BRIM, S/4HANA, functional, technical, and BASIS teams to ensure seamless implementation
* Support data readiness, mock runs, validation, and production execution of archiving activities
* Ensure adherence to data privacy, legal hold, retention, and audit requirements
* Identify and mitigate technical risks related to data volume, performance, and system stability
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to development and support teams
* Prepare and maintain architecture documents, technical designs, and runbooks
* Support cutover, go‑live, and post‑archiving validation activities



  





**Mandatory Skills \& Experience** 



* Strong hands‑on experience as an SAP ILM Technical Architect
* Proven expertise in SAP ILM architecture design, data archiving, and retention management
* Solid understanding of SAP BRIM and SAP S/4HANA data models
* Experience working on large‑scale archiving or system lifecycle management projects
* Strong knowledge of compliance, audit, data privacy, and legal retention requirements
* Excellent stakeholder communication and technical leadership skills



  





**Preferred / Secondary Skills** 



* Experience with SAP ILM Store, Retention Management, and Legal Hold
* Exposure to SAP BRIM modules (FICA, CI, Convergent Mediation)
* Experience working in regulated or audit‑driven enterprise environments
* Ability to work effectively in onsite–offshore delivery models

Omnicell is transforming the future of healthcare technology through a strategic modernization of our global ERP and revenue management landscape. As we advance our SAP S/4HANA journey, we are seeking a highly experienced **SAP RAR \& BRIM Business Analyst** to shape the design and delivery of next\-generation revenue management capabilities.


In this high\-impact role, you will partner with Finance, Revenue Operations, Sales, Customer Experience, and IT leaders to enable scalable subscription\-based business models, streamline order\-to\-cash processes, and ensure revenue recognition compliance across a global organization. This is a unique opportunity to influence enterprise\-wide transformation initiatives while helping build the foundation for Omnicell's future growth.


**What You'll Do**


**Purpose**


Drive the architecture, design, and implementation of SAP Revenue Accounting \& Reporting (RAR) and SAP Billing \& Revenue Innovation Management (BRIM) solutions that support Omnicell's evolving business model, financial compliance requirements, and digital transformation objectives.


As a **SAP RAR \& BRIM Business Analyst**, you will:


**Primary Impact**


Lead the end\-to\-end design and optimization of revenue management and billing solutions that enable accurate financial reporting, operational scalability, and exceptional customer experiences.


* Lead the architecture, solution design, and implementation of SAP RAR and SAP BRIM capabilities across global business functions.
* Design and implement revenue recognition processes aligned with IFRS 15 and ASC 606 accounting standards.
* Configure and optimize SAP RAR functionality, including:
	+ Revenue Accounting Items (RAIs)
	+ Performance Obligations
	+ Standalone Selling Price (SSP) Allocation
	+ Contract Assets and Liabilities
	+ Revenue Deferrals
	+ Revenue Reporting and Reconciliation
* Architect SAP BRIM solutions supporting:
	+ Subscription Order Management (SOM)
	+ Convergent Invoicing (CI)
	+ FI\-CA
	+ Billing and Invoice Consolidation
	+ Contract Management
* Design and oversee integrations between SAP SD, FI/CO, BRIM, RAR, Salesforce, and other enterprise platforms.
* Lead migration initiatives from legacy and Sidecar RAR environments into SAP S/4HANA Embedded RAR.
* Develop solution roadmaps, functional specifications, configuration documentation, test strategies, deployment plans, and architectural standards.
* Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities for automation, process simplification, and operational excellence.
* Provide leadership throughout SIT, UAT, cutover, go\-live, and hyper care phases of transformational programs.
* Establish governance frameworks, solution standards, and SAP Revenue Management best practices.
* Mentor consultants and internal team members to expand organizational SAP RAR and BRIM expertise.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders on revenue management strategy and enterprise architecture decisions.

**Who You Are**


**Minimum Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, Accounting, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
* 10\+ years of SAP functional, solution architecture, or enterprise application experience.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on SAP Revenue Accounting \& Reporting (RAR) implementation and support experience.
* 5\+ years of SAP BRIM implementation experience, including Subscription Order Management (SOM), Convergent Invoicing (CI), and FI\-CA.
* Deep expertise in Order\-to\-Cash, Billing, Revenue Recognition, Financial Accounting, and Revenue Operations processes.
* Experience designing and implementing BRF\+ revenue recognition rules and revenue allocation frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA architecture, integration patterns, and enterprise application landscapes.
* Proven experience leading large\-scale SAP transformation initiatives and collaborating with senior business and technology leaders.
* Exceptional communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* SAP certification in BRIM, RAR, SAP S/4HANA Finance, or related SAP disciplines.
* Experience migrating SAP Sidecar RAR solutions to Embedded RAR within SAP S/4HANA.
* Experience supporting subscription\-based, SaaS, healthcare technology, medical device, or recurring\-revenue business models.
* Experience with SAP Fiori, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) Integration Suite, Cloud ALM, and SAP Analytics solutions.
* Experience supporting global revenue recognition programs and multi\-company implementations.
* Knowledge of Salesforce integrations and enterprise billing ecosystems.
* Demonstrated ability to influence enterprise strategy and drive organizational change.

**Collaborate**


Build strong partnerships across Finance, Revenue Operations, Sales, Customer Experience, and IT teams to deliver integrated, scalable business solutions.

jobs.title: SAP Functional Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:** 




 The Senior SAP Functional analyst is responsible for translating the Business requirements of the Functional Area in two functional areas which is Billing \& Invoicing and FICA or DM performing the duties of systems analysis, design, and development the SAP system via the SAP Configuration IMG (SAP Implementation Guide). This includes all aspects of project work, on\-going functional enhancements, troubleshooting, and SAP provided system and/or legal changes. An SAP Senior Functional Analyst collaborates on all phases of the systems development life\-cycle (SDLC) with a focus on the analysis, design, and development of configuration\-based solutions. Must continuously maintain and develop the necessary skillsets, both technical and analytical to enhance value\-added business solutions and in keeping with the IT architecture.
 



 Under minimal supervision, is responsible for all aspects of the Systems Development Lifecycle (SDLC) in relation to SAP Configuration activities.
 



  





**PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** 




 Implements software solutions for which in\-depth configuration and integration is required; drives substantial interaction with vendor resources and integrates applications with complex interfaces based on specifications provided.
 



 Hands\-on experience in SAP IS\-U Billing \& Invoicing, with deep functional expertise across the meter\-to\-cash lifecycle in the utility industry (Electricity \& Gas).
 



 Expert in configuring and customizing billing master data i.e., billing schemas, rate modelling including complex billing, regulated and de\-regulated tariff models.
 



 Strong knowledge of the end\-to\-end billing and invoicing process including budget billing, RTP billing, TOU billing, mass batch jobs, exception management, bill simulation, unbilled revenue scenarios and collective billing.
 



 Working knowledge of SAP ISU Bill Print, including Print Workbench configuration and integration with Smart Forms and Adobe Forms.
 



 Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams including integration with Device Management and FICA.
 



 Extensive functional and solution experience with the ability to facilitate, design, and develop complex solutions aligned with digital transformation initiatives.
 



 Strong client\-facing skills – ability to serve as a functional liaison between business and IT. Guide stakeholders on best practices.
 



 Experience in SAP S/4 HANA utilities and Fiori; ability to analyze, debug and troubleshoot OData and web services used in integrations.
 



 Participates on an Application Development and Support team as well as project teams under the direction of their Lead SAP Configurator, Manager or Project Managers. Functions as Technical Lead on projects; may lead multiple concurrent projects.
 



 Subject matter expert in multiple business unit areas, including those relevant to projects and application support assignments.
 



 Considered a subject matter expert in their technical discipline; mentors and guides junior staff. Develops and drives standard practices within their team; collaborates with Business Systems Analysts and/or Business Partners to develop software specifications.
 



 Acquires and maintains appropriate technical skills and mentors junior staff. Participates in developing and driving standard practices within their team.
 



 Supports the request and analysis phases of SDLC by assisting with documentation and estimates. Executes the design, development, and implementation phases of SDLC by producing the prescribed deliverables; reviews deliverables produced by junior staff.
 



 Liaises with business partners and business unit leads to conduct analysis and design efforts for future enhancements and configuration to meet changing policy and legislative requirements.
 



 Maintains awareness of current trends in the business marketplace with a focus on product and service development, delivery and support, and applying key technologies. Examine trends in information systems training, materials and techniques. Coordinate system changes by identifying system requirements, definition, testing, training and implementation as well as provide specifications to work management systems, third party remittance, IT, and other areas of the organization.
 



 Participates in business process modeling sessions, while assisting in the collection and consolidation of required information and data in the development of analysis documentation in accordance with the SDLC methodology. Supports the creation of business process procedures for assigned business unit(s).
 



 Develops strong business and system knowledge relating to functional areas and assigned business unit(s). Supports the maintenance and evolution of the logical data model and business process model for assigned business unit(s). Provides input and direction on business unit technology strategies.
 



 Provide training and guidance and oversee work of staff/AMS contractors to ensure quality results.
 



 Development, growth, and mentoring of SAP Configurators.
 



 Should be able to perform budget, forecast, and calculate the actuals for project and maintain financials.
